title: Evaluating LLMs for Historical Document OCR: A Methodological Framework for Digital Humanities

live_model.evidence: Appendix A (model-version table): "OpenAI o4-mini-2025-04-16"; Table 2 row "OpenAI-o4-mini 6.87 9.07" (Full page CER/WER, %).

prompt.location: Sec. 4 (baseline prompt quoted); Appendix C (full prompt-variation experiments)
prompt.note: Baseline prompt requests OCR extraction while preserving Old Russian orthography; two further context-enhanced variants (English, Russian) detailed in Appendix C.

claim.location: Table 2, row OpenAI-o4-mini, Full page / CER (%) column

data.source: 1,029 scanned pages from a National Library of Russia "limited-access collection"; ground-truth transcription "will be released upon publication" (not confirmed released in the text reviewed)

notes: 12 multimodal LLMs evaluated across 3 processing modes; o4-mini is the only one of the three OpenAI models tested (GPT-4o-2024-08-06, GPT-4.1-2025-04-14, o4-mini-2025-04-16) whose snapshot is on the still-callable list. Source page scans come from a restricted archive, so full reproduction needs that access even though methodology and prompts are fully specified.
